content.comment_body: Hello, I'm encountering a problem with my [article_no] PLC. When connecting it to my Windows 7 PC with [product_name] [version_no], I'm able to start and stop the PLC, but cannot download the program—an error appears stating 'Download PC to [product_name] failed.' I have already set the IP address.
Please attach the [product_name] program you attempted to use in a ZIP file in your next post.
You can upload any basic program, or use this sample code. I'm new to [product_name] PLCs, so I don't know how to upload a ZIP file—can you advise how to do that?
Is the program from a previous download to an older [product_name]?
The program was created with [product_name] software, not downloaded. You can upload a sample program using just one input and output.
Have you enabled LSC & LWE access in the access control? Go to: Tools > Transfer > Access Control.
Is the [product_name] device new and empty?

Yes, the [product_name] is new and empty. The firmware version of the PLC is [version_no]. I'm using software versions [version_no], [version_no], and [version_no], but none work for program download. 1) Do I need to select the hardware type? If so, which one should I choose? I also have extension [article_no].

The [product_name] with article number [article_no] is a [product_name] [version_no]. In hardware selection, you should pick [product_name] [version_no]. For this device, you need [product_name] [version_no]. Edit: The expansion module is compatible with this [product_name].
I am using the correct software version ([product_name] [version_no]) and selected the corresponding [product_name] version, but the issue persists.
How is the [product_name] connected to your PC? Is it direct, or are you using a router or switch?

The [product_name] is connected directly to the PC via LAN cable. PLC ([product_name]) IP: 192.168.0.3 Subnet: 255.255.255.0 Default gateway: 192.168.0.1 For the PC: IP 192.168.0.2, subnet 255.255.255.0.
Can you temporarily disable your antivirus and firewall to test if that resolves the issue?

I've tried all suggested settings. Now, I have access to a laptop with Windows 11—can I get the [product_name] software setup so I can install it? I don't have the installation package. Please advise.
No, the license for [product_name] software is valid only for one device. If you want to use it on another laptop or PC, you'll need a separate license for a full installation on that device.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered repeated errors when trying to transfer a program from their PC to a [product_name] device using [product_name] software. Basic connectivity and control functions worked, but program downloading did not. Discourse focused on hardware selection within the software, access control settings, and module compatibility, identifying potential problems with configuration or licensing.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to successfully transfer programs from their PC to their [product_name] module without errors, and wishes to clearly understand hardware and software selection, as well as proper configuration steps.
